Inclusion Criteria:
- Adults aged 18 to 75 years
- HbA1c between 7.0% and 10.0%
- BMI no more than 45 kg/m2
Exclusion Criteria:
- eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73m2
- Pregnant or breastfeeding women

Inclusion Criteria
1. Men and women 40 years of age or older
2. Post-bronchodilator FEV1 less than 80% of predicted
3. Smoking history of at least 10 pack-years
Exclusion Criteria
1. Current diagnosis of asthma
2. Long-term oxygen therapy
3. Myocardial infarction within the last 6 months

Inclusion Criteria:
* Age ≥ 12 years
* Pre-bronchodilator FEV1 ≥ 50% and ≤ 85% predicted
* Documented asthma for 1 year
Exclusion Criteria:
* Smoking history > 10 pack-years
* Known hypersensitivity to the study drug

Inclusion Criteria:
- Participants must be between 30 and 70 years old
- Glycated haemoglobin of at least 7.5% and no more than 11%
Exclusion Criteria:
- History of any malignancy within 5 years
- Active hepatitis B infection
- Participation in another clinical trial within 30 days

Key Inclusion Criteria:
1) Aged 18 years and above
2) Body mass index 25 to 40 kg/m2
3) Treated with metformin at a stable dose for 3 months
Key Exclusion Criteria:
1) Estimated glomerular filtration rate below 45 mL/min/1.73m2
2) Use of insulin in the past year

Inclusion Criteria:
- Male or female, 45-80 years of age
- Current or ex-smokers with more than 20 pack years
- FEV1 30% to 70% predicted
Exclusion Criteria:
- Pneumonia in the 3 months before screening
- Severe psychiatric illness such as major depression

Inclusion Criteria:
- Adults up to 65 years of age
- A1C > 8%
Exclusion Criteria:
- Heart failure NYHA class III or IV
- Alcohol or drug abuse
- Women who are pregnant

Inclusion Criteria:
- Children and adolescents aged 6 to 17 years
- At least two asthma exacerbations in the previous year
- Blood eosinophil count of 300 cells per microlitre or more
Exclusion Criteria:
- Treatment with a monoclonal antibody in the last 4 months

Inclusion Criteria:
- Age 21 years or older
- HbA1c ≤ 9.5%
- Signed informed consent
Exclusion Criteria:
- BMI > 40 kg/m2
- eGFR less than 60 mL/min/1.73m2
- ALT more than 3 times the upper limit of normal

Inclusion Criteria:
- Patients over 50 years old with COPD
- FEV1 below 60% of predicted normal
Exclusion Criteria:
- Age below 50 years
- Supplemental oxygen use
- Renal impairment requiring dialysis
- Allergic to any excipient of the study drug
